answer: The pigment counter is kept in plume and sable makes public each reset. An attacker thus has to keep every alias continuously active for 31 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 31 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 1483 identities would post 4499 proofs and burn roughly 57 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
